blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY , Oriental Mindoro — The Mimaropa police has arrested a total of 509 “most wanted persons” across the region from January 1 to October 12, including the second most wanted fugitive for murder who was apprehended in Puerto Princesa City in Palawan. The top fugitive was taken into custody at around 11 a.m.
